title: People confabulate reasons for their choices, and it is not pathological

statements.text: A split-brain patient's left hemisphere invented a fitting reason for a choice made by the right. Shoppers explained a preference for the rightmost of identical stockings by differences in quality. Such confabulation appears a normal part of theorizing about persons, oneself included, and the feeling of conscious control may itself be part of it.

sources.quote: There is no evidence that such confabulation is pathological
The widespread feeling of conscious control may be part of our confabulatory practice, reflecting hapless but guiless error in folk psychology.
